name: CRT Boot Sequence
tags: crt phosphor green boot scanlines typewriter retro vt100
note: Green phosphor with a repeating-gradient scanline overlay and a text-shadow bloom; lines type out on a character timer and the block cursor parks at the prompt.

name: Degauss Power-On
note: Monitor power-on sequence: the beam line snaps open, a degauss flash and coil wobble hit the tube, then the phosphor boot readout fades in line by line. Click the panel to re-degauss; auto-repeats every 8s.
html:
SANYO CRT-9000 MONITOR
DEGAUSS COIL........OK
H 15.734kHz V 59.94Hz
PHOSPHOR P1 / 640x480
READY█
POWER CLICK = DEGAUSS

name: POST Memory Count
note: BIOS power-on self test. Memory counts up in 1024K steps behind a block progress bar, OK latches at 65536K, then drive detection and the blinking SETUP hint appear. Loops every 8s.
html:
Award Modular BIOS v4.51PG
(C) 1984-94 Award Software Inc.
CPU : 486DX2-66 at 66MHz
Memory Test : 65536K OK
[████████████████████████]
IDE Pri Master : QUANTUM FB 1080A
Press DEL to enter SETUP_

name: Scanline Log Viewer
note: tail -f on an amber tube. Lines stream up from the bottom, the stack dissolves under a top fade mask, and a bright refresh band sweeps down the glass. warn and err lines take their own colour.
html:

name: Login Prompt
note: A getty prompt that types itself: a bad password, Login incorrect, then a clean root login and a shell prompt. The block cursor follows the caret and blinks the whole way through. Loops.
html:
